ideas.pitch: An immersive AR navigation and crowd density visualizer for Kolkata underground transit systems, blending cyberpunk aesthetics with practical city navigation.
ideas.title: KolkataMetroAR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the GTA VI inspired theme with actual low-latency AR tech demonstrated live, following the precedent of BaseScanning.

ideas.pitch: An automated compliance and risk intelligence dashboard specifically built for local urban vendors and small businesses in Bidhannagar.
ideas.title: ChaiAuditAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines localized utility with graph intelligence and explainable machine learning, a proven formula seen in Bito.

ideas.pitch: An open-world crime and incident forecasting simulator utilizing Poisson regression models to predict urban bottlenecks and safety incidents in high-traffic zones.
ideas.title: StreetSmartKolkata
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the grand theft open-world aesthetic while applying rigorous statistical modeling seen in winning AI forecasting projects.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform analyzing the biomechanics of traditional dance forms like Dhunuchi Naach for fitness scoring and cultural archiving.
ideas.title: DurgaPujoBiomech
ideas.why_it_could_win: Deeply localized cultural hook combined with hard computer vision pose estimation, mirroring the success of CricketVision_AI.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and drone image monitoring pipeline for detecting industrial land compliance and water quality issues along the Hooghly riverfront.
ideas.title: HooghlyEcoMonitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a massive regional infrastructure problem using robust remote-sensing models, following the GeoNex-ATLAS pattern.
